name: Pizzeria Casanova
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria Casanova in Tirol**

Welcome to **Pizzeria Casanova** in the heart of **Tirol**! Here, authentic Italian flavors meet the charm of the Alps. Enjoy our freshly baked pizzas, handmade pasta, and delicious **Kaiserschmarrn**—all crafted with the finest local ingredients.

Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Tiroler Gröstl** pizza, or a sweet **Apfelstrudel**, our menu has something for everyone. Pair your meal with a glass of crisp Italian wine or a refreshing **Tiroler Bergkäse** beer.

Located in the vibrant city of **Innsbruck**, we’re just a short stroll from the **Goldenes Dachl** and the scenic **Inn River**. Come taste the perfect blend of Italian passion and **Tiroler** hospitality—your taste buds won’t know what hit them!
